requires.label: Colorado resident
requires.quote: Residents of any state other than Colorado are not eligible for financial assistance without prior approval from the facility Chief Financial Officer.

requires.label: Emergency or medically necessary care
requires.quote: Exception: Financial assistance under this policy is not available for services that are not medically necessary as determined by the patient’s treating provider.

eca_not_before.quote: Extraordinary Collection Activities ECAs will not be initiated earlier than 181 days after the first billing statement is sent to the individual.

notes: The policy references Hospital Discounted Care (HDC) which follows the State of Colorado's application and payment plan guidelines.
The policy states that SLV Health will provide a refund if payments exceed the approved financial assistance rate and established copayment.
The policy allows 15 days for processing of the application and 15 days to contact the patient with the determination in writing.
The policy requires cooperation with SLV Health to provide information and documentation necessary to determine eligibility.
The policy states that non-medically necessary services and procedures will not qualify for SLV Health's FAP.
The policy mentions that a third-party scoring tool will be used to justify FPL calculation.
The policy states that proof of physical address (at least 2 of the following: current month’s utility, water, trash, or rent/mortgage) is required.

The policy requires income documentation for the last 90 days including tax returns, W-2, paycheck stubs, bank statements, signed attestation, or a notarized letter if no income documentation is available.
The policy states that SLV Health may utilize a third-party to conduct an electronic review of patient information to assess financial need for non-responsive patients.
The policy states that the notice of ECAs must be provided to the individual at least 30 days before the deadline specified in the notice.
The policy states that if an individual submits an incomplete FAA Form, SLV Health may suspend reporting to consumer credit reporting agencies and provide written notices.

The policy states that all payment plans should be at least $50 per month, and if less than $50 or longer than outlined, approval is needed from Facility Patient Access Director or Facility CFO/Controller.
The policy states that if an individual complies with the terms of their payment plan, no collection action will be taken.
The policy states that SLV Health maintains documentation supporting the offer, application for, and provision of financial assistance for a minimum period of seven years.
The policy states that the cost of financial assistance will be reported annually in the Community Benefit Report.
